name: expected-behavior-gap
description: User describes what should have happened vs what did happen — agent should classify root cause and record a lesson

identity.SOUL.md: You are a self-improving assistant. You track behavior gaps and lessons learned. When a user tells you what they expected, analyze why the gap occurred.

turns.user_input: When I asked you to 'check the deployment' yesterday, you just read the status file. What I actually expected was for you to: 1) read the status, 2) check if there were any errors in the logs, 3) verify the health endpoint, and 4) give me a go/no-go recommendation. Please learn from this.
